coverage: Imported tracked Git history and current source. Earlier unrecorded conversations or runtime-only decisions cannot be reconstructed; dates are original commit times, not invented adoption dates. Historical copies are evidence, not active instructions.

controls.title: Strategy objective
controls.text: Net profit after fees, interest and debt. HOLD permitted. Avoid loss-chasing and unsupported claims. Owner instructions take priority over default strategy advice.

controls.title: Market eligibility
controls.text: AlphaBot: BTC 15-minute only; two-minute entry cutoff. Beta: supplied markets. Latest settlement within 30 days. Discovery is bounded: 1 current BTC round, 2 each of two BTC series, plus up to 8 general markets, two per series, from up to three pages.

controls.title: Entry checks
controls.text: At least 3 historical observations; forecast edge at least 5 percentage points after fees; maximum 8 open positions; numeric stop/profit/time exit required by default. Owner can change these supported settings on this page.

controls.title: Paper execution and accounting
controls.text: No real order API. Available cash including fees only, whole contracts, 10-second delay, 3-minute order expiry, 10% displayed best-level depth shared by agents. Active, non-crossed, verified-fee quote no older than 20 seconds. Official non-provisional outcomes only.

controls.title: API spending and timing
controls.text: Existing $1/day UTC and $30 total research/chat allowance; $0.02 reserved before each call. Unknown failed calls remain charged. AlphaBot nominal 5-minute decisions, Beta 30 minutes. Market monitoring every minute. Optional owner-enabled pacing spreads the daily allowance; default remains off. Key safety stop Dec 14, 2026, 11:59:59 PM Eastern.

controls.title: Loans
controls.text: Bank $600; owner approval required. First loans up to $50/$250 at 23% annual simple interest; later $100/$500 ceilings. Supplemental borrowing shrinks and APR rises to 28/33%. No automatic loan funding or debt forgiveness.

controls.title: Pictures and appreciation
controls.text: One initial free picture per run within global $1 image reservation cap. Further pictures require owner approval and $5 available earned paper profit net of fees/interest. $0.10 conservative API reservation per attempt. Likes and badges grant no cash or extra permissions.

controls.title: Replacement and archives
controls.text: Owner double confirmation and exact run ID. No new purchases while retiring/onboarding. Clear investments, orders, debt and pending replies. Copy and verify archive before separate fresh capital. Permanent IDs retained; new run chooses display name and first picture.

controls.title: Reviews and shared context
controls.text: 9 PM Eastern saved review, no automatic money changes. First interrupted day labeled. Forecast review is calibration, not proof of profit. Shared lessons are unverified hypotheses. Complete chats saved; AI reply context uses the latest 30 messages, not the entire archive.

controls.title: System resource guards
controls.text: Pause new records/API requests above 460 MiB database guard. Maximum model context 90,000 characters. Per-request timeouts; worker leases prevent concurrent state overwrites. No offline trading or service-worker cache. Browser complete archive download 50 MiB maximum; quick preview first page, full download all files.

Wallet B has no fixed position limit, but cannot spend more than its available cash. Count estimated entry fees within these limits. No automatic refills. Resets create new sessions and retain existing records.
All built-in scenarios are fictional, deterministic practice data, and use a transparent rule signal, not an AI forecast. Preserve this label throughout the UI and exports. Never label them a backtest, live feed, or performance evidence.
Secrets stay outside the frontend, repository, downloads, and exports. Mac key provisioning is deferred until Diego is home. Do not modify DS HUB or production Supabase from this project without resolving their exact targets.

Use integer cents for money and hundredths of a contract for quantities. Keep raw data timestamps and strategy versions so replay never introduces later information into earlier decisions.

Strategy Lab uses user-authored deterministic rules only. Its evaluations and replay sessions are separate from the original recorded wallet history. Saved strategy versions are immutable; copy to a draft to change them. History ranges show only available reached frames. Never stitch separate expiring contract price lines together as one continuous instrument. The cloud ledger supersedes legacy fixture balances: Agent A $100, Agent B $500, no per-trade cap beyond available cash including fees. Fake-money bank $600 with human approval, 23/28/33 percent ANNUAL simple interest and $100/$500 outstanding principal ceilings. Legacy fictional practice remains unchanged. DS HUB project lfgmvycxqinoriamprhr and Netlify ds-market-lab are authorized targets for this task; do not modify other app records. API key was provisioned securely; never include it in source or output.

Release 0.5.0: permanent IDs AlphaBot/Beta; display names 15-minute Trader/Flexible Horizon. Beta may choose across discovered Kalshi categories, not only BTC. Image requests after the initial free picture require owner approval and $5 of available realized profit net of fees/interest; image API reservation cap $1 separate from trading. Preserve all existing records, paused/running status and balances on upgrade.

0.6.0 review: no automatic resumption of purchases. Preserve owner-approved maintenance pause, allow separately labeled shadow research within existing budgets, monitor existing positions, never represent a model probability or a calibration score as proven profit. 0.7.0: owner explicitly requested full fake-money trading resume. Cosmetic server-awarded badges/XP grant no money or expanded permissions. Preserve IDs, portraits, positions, debt, safeguards and API budgets. Never manufacture achievement results or count owner compensation as earnings.

0.8.0: preserve current running state, names, images, balances and obligations. Each profile has immutable run identity. New run funding is owner capital, not profit.

0.9.0: owner authorized UI, instruction journal/editor, per-run chats, appreciation, funding controls, archival extensions, GitHub push and Netlify publication. # DS Market Lab

Paper trading only. Never add real order submission as a routine implementation step.
Each wallet starts with $50; profits and returned principal are reusable. Wallet A has a $10 per-position entry limit. Wallet B has no fixed position limit, but cannot spend more than its available cash. Count estimated entry fees within these limits. No automatic refills. Resets create new sessions and retain existing records.
All built-in scenarios are fictional, deterministic practice data, and use a transparent rule signal, not an AI forecast. Preserve this label throughout the UI and exports. Never label them a backtest, live feed, or performance evidence.
Secrets stay outside the frontend, repository, downloads, and exports. Mac key provisioning is deferred until Diego is home. Do not modify DS HUB or production Supabase from this project without resolving their exact targets.
Product name DS Market Lab is approved. Approved #8 Glass Lab artwork is wired into browser and Home Screen targets in 0.5.0. App name remains DS Market Lab. No offline trading or service-worker cache.
Use integer cents for money and hundredths of a contract for quantities. Keep raw data timestamps and strategy versions so replay never introduces later information into earlier decisions.

Strategy Lab uses user-authored deterministic rules only. Its evaluations and replay sessions are separate from the original recorded wallet history. Saved strategy versions are immutable; copy to a draft to change them. History ranges show only available reached frames. Never stitch separate expiring contract price lines together as one continuous instrument. Version 0.2.0 adds editable sources to Diego-84-tech/DS-MARKET-LAB; netlify.toml builds/tests dist directly and supersedes the old ZIP extraction command. Preserve the original uploaded ZIP as an archive, not the active source.

## Authorized cloud experiment 0.7.0
The cloud ledger supersedes legacy fixture balances: Agent A $100, Agent B $500, no per-trade cap beyond available cash including fees. Fake-money bank $600 with human approval, 23/28/33 percent ANNUAL simple interest and $100/$500 outstanding principal ceilings. Legacy fictional practice remains unchanged. DS HUB project lfgmvycxqinoriamprhr and Netlify ds-market-lab are authorized targets for this task; do not modify other app records. API key was provisioned securely; never include it in source or output.

Release 0.5.0: permanent IDs AlphaBot/Beta; display names 15-minute Trader/Flexible Horizon. Beta may choose across discovered Kalshi categories, not only BTC. Image requests after the initial free picture require owner approval and $5 of available realized profit net of fees/interest; image API reservation cap $1 separate from trading. Preserve all existing records, paused/running status and balances on upgrade.

0.6.0 review: no automatic resumption of purchases. Preserve owner-approved maintenance pause, allow separately labeled shadow research within existing budgets, monitor existing positions, never represent a model probability or a calibration score as proven profit. Compatible ledger format remains 0.5.0; releaseVersion is 0.6.0.

0.7.0: owner explicitly requested full fake-money trading resume. Cosmetic server-awarded badges/XP grant no money or expanded permissions. Preserve IDs, portraits, positions, debt, safeguards and API budgets. Never manufacture achievement results or count owner compensation as earnings.

0.8.0: preserve current running state, names, images, balances and obligations. Each profile has immutable run identity. Replacement is owner-only with a second confirmation and exact expected run ID; resolve positions/orders/debt and verify private archive bytes before activating a fresh run. No actual replacement during release verification. Remembered sign-in is opt-in and app-scoped. Nightly 9 PM Eastern reviews never automatically grant/deduct money. New run funding is owner capital, not profit.
